title: Directory access is explicit
summary: A Directory block applies settings to a filesystem directory. Access rules should expose only intended public files.
introduction: A Directory block applies settings to a filesystem directory. Access rules should expose only intended public files. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Directory block applies settings to a filesystem directory. Access rules should expose only intended public files.
The example allows access to this specific public directory and disables automatic directory listings.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why a private notes directory should not use this public rule.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Never grant public access to an entire home directory just to serve one page.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).

seo.title: Apache HTTP Server: Directory access is explicit
seo.description: Learn about directory access is explicit in Apache HTTP Server. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
